thread:
incident-bot: PAGER: Canary health alert for model 'redwood/gamma-v2' in us-west-2 — spike in tokenization/decoder errors (5xx) at 03:05 UTC. Severity: P0. Dashboard: <http://ops/redwood/incidents/6081234567>

maria: I'm oncall and looking. Can anyone confirm deploy started around 03:00?

deploy-bot: deploy event: rollout started for redwood/gamma-v2 -> canary pool at 2026-03-17T03:00:12Z (job id: deploy-60812)

jon: seeing repeated errors in canary logs — tokenization: unknown token id 50213, and decoder exceptions saying mismatch between tokenizer and model state.

alex: also seeing WARN from weights-loader: "checksum mismatch: expected sha256=aa3f... got=bb7c..." — looks like weights bundle doesn't match expected artifact.

irene: this smells like a mismatched promotion where a tokenizer version didn't get promoted with the weights. Can we pause canary traffic?

maria: yes. Flipping canary feature flag to stop traffic to new variant.

maria: executing: curl -s -X POST https://flags.internal/api/flip -d 'flag=canary.redwood.gamma-v2&value=false'

deploy-bot: feature flag flip succeeded (flag=canary.redwood.gamma-v2 -> false)

jon: traffic to canaries paused. Error rate dropping on upstream, but a small number of requests already returned corrupted completions. CS -> affected customers: 2 accounts in EU.

sam-cs: confirmed — we've received 2 support pings. Samples show truncated/compressed tokens that don't decode. No PII in the samples. Ticket #INC-2486 created.

alex: quick root cause: artifact tag "gamma-v2-hotcut" resolved to weights set for gamma-v1 while the model binary and tokenizer were v2. Promotion pipeline likely picked wrong weightset manifest. Reproduced locally by inspecting artifact metadata: "weights_sha": "bb7c..." vs expected "aa3f...".

maria: options: (1) promote correct weightset to the tag, (2) rollback canaries to gamma-v1, (3) keep canary traffic off and manually replace weights. What's safest for customer impact?

irene: prefer rollback to last known-good (gamma-v1) for speed. Promote requires validating weight/tokenizer hashes which takes longer.

maria: agree. Initiating rollback.

maria: redwoodctl rollout rollback --service=model-serving --target=redwood/gamma-v1 --reason "hotcut artifact mismatch"

deploy-bot: rollback job queued (rollback-60812). Progress: 0% -> estimated completion 2m

jon: seeing degraded error count already dropping ~70% within 90s of flag flip + rollback start.

alex: I'm quarantining the artifact tag in the registry (write-protect) and adding a temporary block on further promotions until we root cause.

maria: good. Sam, please update status page and notify the two impacted accounts that we're rolling back and investigating. Keep it short: service degraded for small subset; rollback in progress.

sam-cs: Posted status update and emailed customers with sample requests and next steps. They're appreciative of the quick rollback.

incident-bot: Incident state changed -> under_control at 03:15 UTC. Pager notifications silenced.

maria: quick postmortem notes: immediate mitigation = feature flag flip + rollback to redwood/gamma-v1. Customer impact = limited: two EU customers saw malformed completions; no data leakage. Root cause = registry/promotion bug that allowed tag -> wrong weightset (tokenizer/weights mismatch). Action items: 1) block promotions until validation; 2) add tokenizer-weightset hash preflight check in CI; 3) audit recent promotions for similar tags; 4) postmortem owner: jon, ETA for fixed release pipeline: 24h.

jon: taking ownership for postmortem. I'll collect artifact manifests, CI logs, and reproduce the promotion race locally. Starting draft now.

irene: SRE follow-up: add alert rule to detect tokenization mismatch errors (unknown token id spikes) and tie to deploy traces so we can auto-isolate deployments faster.

alex: I'll coordinate the registry hotfix and add a server-side validation to reject weightset promotions that don't match tokenizer hash.

maria: thanks everyone. Handing off to jon for timeline and root cause. If any escalation needed, tag me and SRE lead.

jon: ACK — will update this thread with postmortem link when ready.

maria: incident closed for oncall handoff. Summary recorded in ops log.

sam-cs: closing customer tickets pending confirmation. Will re-open if customers still see issues.

maria: final note: no rollbacks required for prod (canary did not fully promote). Marking severity as P0-> mitigated. Follow-ups scheduled.
